code.detail: Two per-splitter-channel AnalyserNodes set channelCount=1 and channelCountMode=explicit before any connection. Each input limb is mono for both mono and stereo sources, so this fixes its existing channel contract without changing monitoring matrix coefficients, source scheduling, cue or gain.

evidence.harnessReview: Actual PlayerService/settings bundled through webpack. Native realtime AudioWorklet capture accounts for each frame and compares both channels including frames 0..127; offline capture also starts at frame zero. No prefix discard. Sample-rate mismatch and missing/duplicate realtime frames fail. Before/after temporary PlayerService copies differ only by the four assignments and explanatory comments.

limits: PCM capture is native Chrome real-time/offline rendering, not physical device output or subjective listening.
32 representative startup cases cover 44.1/48 kHz, mono/stereo and key matrix modes; this does not independently certify every filter/EQ/band-solo or visibility-toggle timing case.
evidenceClarification: The first verifier before/after sha256 fields are PlayerService source hashes; separate report-file hashes are supplied here. The requested top-level product-after-final path does not exist; the referenced audio-review/product-after-final report was reviewed.
